fields.description: When enabled, non-Administrator Project and Task access is additionally restricted to documents the user owns or that are explicitly shared with that user. Controlled Task workflow actions are also enabled.
fields.label: Enable ERPNext Project Access

fields.options: Currently disabled: ERPNext Project Access is installed but not active. Enabling it can immediately reduce which existing Projects and Tasks non-Administrator users can see. Review ownership and explicit shares before enabling it on an existing site.

Currently enabled: The owner-or-explicit-share access fence and controlled Task workflow are active. Disabling this setting removes that additional fence and may allow users with broader native ERPNext permissions to see more Projects or Tasks. Review your normal roles and permissions before disabling it.
